course_name_original: Design of Steam Boilers and Heat Exchangers
course_name_en: Design of Steam Boilers and Heat Exchangers

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to distinguish common heat exchanger types.
Ability to apply knowledge of advantages and limitations of common heat exchanger types in type synthesis.
Ability to find properties of fluids from tables and evaluate them at the right conditions
Ability to find appropriate heat transfer and friction coefficient (h) correlations and use them in the design
Ability to calculate heat transfer rate and pressure drop.
Ability to determine heat transfer area requirement for a given set of design requirements
Ability to rate the performance of a given heat exchanger.
Ability to recognize importance of fouling.

syllabus_topics: Energy Balance and Basic Design Methods (LMTD & Effectiveness-NTU)
Heat Transfer and Pressure Drop Correlations
bibliography: Buhar kazanları Isıl Hesapları, Kemal Onat, Osman F. Genceli, Ahmet Arısoy
Buhar Kazanlarının Konstrüksiyonu, Osman F. Genceli, Heat Exchangers: Selection, Rating, and Thermal Design, Third Edition, Sadik Kakaç, Hongtan Liu, Anchasa Pramuanjaroenkij
